unit.label: meta-
unit.core_meaning: beyond, after, or a change of
unit.mentor_note: Meta always steps outside the thing it names. Metaphysics stands beyond physics; metamorphosis is a change of the form itself. When you meet it in an argument, ask what the writer has stepped outside of.

members.meaning: the branch of philosophy that deals with what lies beyond physics
the bones of the hand beyond the wrist
the spread of a disease beyond its original site
a language used to describe another language

predict_options.text: Beyond, after, or a change of something
Against or in opposition to something

discovery.understand_note: Meta marks a step outside or past: past physics, past the wrist, past one form into another. In CAT reading it often signals a writer commenting on the discussion itself rather than on its subject.

applies.prompt: Knowing meta- means beyond or about, what do you think a metalanguage is?

options.text: A language used to talk about another language
A language spoken by very few people
The oldest ancestor of a language family
